name: Brace
description: Plant the feet and guard. Affects only the user. The target guards until its next turn.

name: Rally Cry
description: A shout that stiffens an ally's arm. Teammates only. Attack +10% for 2 turns.

name: Study Foe
description: Pick out the weak spot. Enemies only. Marked for 3 turns.

name: Fleet Foot
description: Lighten the step. Affects only the user. Move +25% for 2 turns.

name: Signal Flare
description: A flare that leaves the foe exposed for a blow. Enemies only. Exposed (25% more damage) for 1 turn.

name: Swap Meet
description: Trade places with anyone, no questions. The user and the target change places.

name: Fortify
description: Raise a ward on an ally. Teammates only. Warded (25% less damage) for 2 turns.

name: Hasten
description: An ally acts sooner and moves faster. Teammates only. Speed +15% for 2 turns. Brings the target's next turn sooner.

name: Taunting Shout
description: The foe loses its rhythm. Enemies only. Delays the target's next turn.

name: Ankle Snare
description: A snare holds one foe. Enemies only. Rooted (cannot walk) for 1 turn.

name: Shift Places
description: Pull an ally out of danger by taking their place. Teammates only. The user and the target change places.

name: Bulwark
description: Allies near the aim guard and harden. Teammates only. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one. Defense +15% for 2 turns. The target guards until its next turn.

name: Battle Hymn
description: Allies near the aim strike harder. Teammates only. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one. Attack +15% for 3 turns.

name: Grapple Line
description: A line that reels a foe in. Enemies only. Drags the target 3 tiles toward the user.

name: Disrupt Formation
description: Throw the foe's timing off. Enemies only. Delays the target's next turn.

name: Scout's Eye
description: A long look: quicker and surer on rough ground. Affects only the user. Move +25% for 2 turns. Jump +50% for 2 turns.

name: Surprise Party
description: Allies near the aim get a little SP and a head start. Teammates only. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one. Gives 2 SP. Brings the target's next turn sooner.

name: Haste
description: An ally's turns come sooner. Teammates only. Hasted (speed +50%) for 3 turns.

name: Mass Haste
description: Allies near the aim speed up. Teammates only. Reaches every tile within 2 of the aimed one. Hasted (speed +50%) for 3 turns.

name: Smelling Salts
description: Wakes a sleeper and clears a stun. Teammates only. Wakes and cures: sleep, stun.

name: Flank Order
description: An ally moves at once. Teammates only. Brings the target's next turn sooner.

name: Phalanx
description: Allies near the aim are warded. Teammates only. Reaches every tile within 2 of the aimed one. Warded (25% less damage) for 2 turns.

name: Entangle
description: Roots hold every foe near the aim. Enemies only. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one. Rooted (cannot walk) for 1 turn.

name: Weak Point
description: Open the target's guard wide. Enemies only. Exposed (25% more damage) for 3 turns. Defense -20% for 3 turns.

name: Grand Strategy
description: Allies near the aim attack harder and act faster. Teammates only. Reaches every tile within 2 of the aimed one. Attack +20% for 3 turns. Speed +15% for 3 turns.

name: Time Fold
description: An ally acts again almost at once. Teammates only. Brings the target's next turn sooner.

name: Checkmate
description: One foe, no moves left. Enemies only. Rooted (cannot walk) for 2 turns. Exposed (25% more damage) for 2 turns. Delays the target's next turn.

name: Commander's Aura
description: Allies near the aim are warded, renewed and stronger. Teammates only. Reaches every tile within 3 of the aimed one. Warded (25% less damage) for 3 turns. Regen (8% hp a turn) for 3 turns. Attack +20% for 3 turns.

name: Stalemate
description: Every foe near the aim is stopped cold. Enemies only. Reaches every tile within 2 of the aimed one. Rooted (cannot walk) for 1 turn. Silenced (no skills) for 2 turns. Delays the target's next turn.
